background_rule: Override only target QPS; every other task remains identical positive low load at every point and for both pools. VQA is a mandatory Generalist background.
candidate_order: First user preferred triple. If it fails, keep preferred LOW/MID unchanged and derive HIGH from each admitted target G/S pair, sorted by measured G1+S1 safe memory and identity; fractions .1,.25,.5 in that order. This is CPU design from capacity equations, not post-GPU retuning.
derived_HIGH_formula: C_S_op + fraction*C_G_remaining; C_S_op=.8*g_S1/s_S,target; C_G_remaining=(.8*g_G1-sum(non-target admitted G background r*s0))/s_G,target. Mandatory uncovered tasks still require admitted Specialists in complete optimizer. These are candidate generators only.
primary: minimum empirical safe residency, all legal models and measured counts compete
secondary: identical J among all exact minimum-resource states; Module16 independent strict convex numerical certificate may be reused, original Module9/V3 remains unchanged
LOW_condition: No resident target-capable Specialist, target entirely G, same G across all stages; other task Specialists may reside.
MID_condition: Resident target Specialist and >=80% target offered routing goes to S; optimizer-selected, no forced identity/route.
HIGH_condition: Both G/S target routes positive, same G as LOW/MID, rho<=.8, joint residual OPERATIONAL target capacity >=1% of target QPS and expected target G and S completions each >=3 per120s. At rho=.8 a worker still has20% measured physical headroom; individual operational guards may bind.
known_speech_bottleneck_exclusion: Never permit ASR=1/LID=12 combination. Reject any witness containing the Module16/17 active medium+turbo pattern with a speech worker predicted demand >=.4; do not apply local2.06 multiplier to any task/model. Single speech path low-load background is explicitly not a calibrated concurrency guarantee.
pool_order: For each target solve FULL_HEAVY first; controlled COMMON_G only if no full-pool witness. Report both independently. Prefer full-pool successful witness.

GPU_protocol.stop: Immediately skip remaining repetitions/phases of a task after any unstable/runtime/memory/release failure. If a completed phase has any recoverable_congested, reject task and skip next phases. Continue next independently frozen task if GPU released.
